precedence: The Constitution, primary legislation and the consolidated text current on the applicable date govern legal rules. Later corrective provisions prevail only within their express scope and effective period.
SRC-27 governs the constitutional issue decided by judgment 89/2026 within the scope and time period stated by the Court.
SRC-11 governs approval of the 2025 model package; SRC-12 and SRC-13 provide official interpretive guidance but cannot override primary legislation or the approved model.
SRC-14 governs the payment codes and payment descriptions expressly established by the resolution.
SRC-23 through SRC-26 govern the annual legal-interest rate and related usufruct/life-annuity coefficients only for their stated year.
SRC-01 overrides SRC-05 only for the instruction portions explicitly modified.
SRC-09 overrides SRC-08 and SRC-07 only for the technical elements and controls explicitly modified.

SRC-08 is the current machine-readable authority for XML/XSD syntax, namespaces, types, order, cardinality, enumerations and imports; SRC-07 is the corresponding human-readable technical documentation.
SRC-10 is the specialist authority for the autoliquidation calculation process from 1 January 2025, together with the applicable instructions and technical constraints.
SRC-03 governs visible labels, field inventory, sections and order; SRC-04 and SRC-05 govern semantics and compilation instructions.
SRC-15 proves the official SUC13 control-software version and office-list update; it does not replace the XSD or technical specifications.

SRC-32 through SRC-40 preserve the official Desktop Telematico and SUC13 software distribution as operational evidence; software never overrides legislation, the approved model, instructions or technical specifications, and its currency must still be checked against the live official services before qualification.
SRC-28, SRC-30 and SRC-31 are operational references; SRC-29 is a historical paper model. They do not override the approved current model, instructions, XSD or legislation.
SRC-02, SRC-06 and SRC-17 are retained as official lineage and regression material and cannot override later sources within their applicable period.
Unresolved conflicts block the affected export.
